about: Your recent searches, newest first. adding: the list after searching for query; the query is kept trimmed, moves to the front once whatever its case, a blank one isn't kept, and only the newest ten stay. offered: which recent searches the search field offers while query is typed; an empty field offers the newest five, and typing offers up to three that contain it, leaving out the one it already says.

adding.name: A search moves to the front once, whatever its case or spacing
The first search starts the list
Only the newest ten are kept

offered.name: An empty field offers recent searches
An empty field offers the newest five
Typing offers the ones that contain it, ignoring case, but not the same search again
